mapper.update: update user set last_login_at=now() where login_id=#{loginId}

update user set name=#{name},email=#{email},nickname=#{nickname},birth_date=#{birthDate},phone=#{phone}, account_updated_at=case when account_created_at is not null and not (bank_name <=> #{bankName} and account_number <=> #{accountNumber} and account_holder <=> #{accountHolder}) then now() else account_updated_at end, account_created_at=case when account_created_at is null and #{accountNumber} is not null then now() else account_created_at end, bank_name=#{bankName},account_number=#{accountNumber},account_holder=#{accountHolder},updated_at=now() where login_id=#{loginId}

update user set profile_image=nullif(#{profileImage},''), preferred_region1=#{preferredRegion1},preferred_region2=#{preferredRegion2},preferred_region3=#{preferredRegion3}, preferred_sport1=#{preferredSport1},preferred_sport2=#{preferredSport2},preferred_sport3=#{preferredSport3}, soccer_skill=#{soccerSkill},basketball_skill=#{basketballSkill},tennis_skill=#{tennisSkill},badminton_skill=#{badmintonSkill},bio=#{bio},profile_updated_at=now() where login_id=#{loginId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from user u left join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'NORMAL' and (u.suspended = 0 or u.suspended is null)) or (#{status} = 'SUSPENDED' and u.suspended = 1) or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or u.login_id like concat('%', '#{keyword}', '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', '#{keyword}', '%') )

select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.suspended, p.score from user u left join user_penalty p on p.user_id = u.user_id and p.penalty_id = ( select max(p2.penalty_id) from user_penalty p2 where p2.user_id = u.user_id ) where u.grade = 'User' and ( #{status} = 'ALL' or (#{status} = 'NORMAL' and (u.suspended = 0 or u.suspended is null)) or (#{status} = 'SUSPENDED' and u.suspended = 1) or (#{status} = 'PENALTY' and p.score != 0) ) and ( #{keyword} = '' or u.login_id like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) order by u.user_id desc limit #{row}, 10

select u.user_id, u.login_id, u.nickname, u.suspended, u.withdrawal_at, u.email, p.score, p.permanent_suspension, p.received_at, p.suspension_start_at, p.suspension_end_at, p.reason, p.penalty_id from user u left join user_penalty p on u.user_id = p.user_id where u.user_id = #{userId} order by p.penalty_id asc
mapper.insert: insert into user_penalty (user_id, received_at, score, reason, suspension_start_at, suspension_end_at, permanent_suspension) values (#{userId}, now(), #{score}, #{reason}, now(), date_add(now(), interval #{days} day), 0)
